name: Spicy Cottage Cheese "Nacho" Dip with Carrots and Celery
ingredients: ⅔ cup shredded cheese, Mexican blend
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel garlic and add to the blender.

Add cottage cheese, shredded cheese, salsa, and chili powder to the blender. Blend on high for several minutes until smooth, scraping down the sides of the blender as needed. Add water, 1 tablespoon at a time, if needed, to reach desired consistency. Set aside.
Peel, trim, and quarter carrots lengthwise, then cut crosswise into 3-inch long sticks.
Trim and halve celery lengthwise, then cut crosswise into 3-inch long sticks.
Divide dip between bowls and serve with veggie sticks on the side. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
